language.name: English
neighbors_hint: Neighbor cache grouped by MAC, retaining IPv4/IPv6 and all interfaces. Entries without a usable MAC remain separate. The router flag comes from the kernel; an absent flag does not prove lack of routing capability. STALE does not mean offline.
wifi_hint: Known Wi-Fi networks from the NetworkManager cache. No new Wi-Fi scan is triggered. SIGNAL is relative strength in percent.
services_hint: Local TCP/UDP sockets. Process details may be unavailable without administrator rights. A local port is not necessarily reachable from the network.
name: Interface
IS101: Log directory is not writable. Check directory permissions; details appear in the terminal.
IS102: Settings could not be read or saved. Check config/settings.json and permissions; read errors use defaults.
IS103: Language file missing or invalid. Restore UTF-8 JSON with text keys and values.
IS105: HTML help for the selected language is missing or cannot be opened. Check help/<code>.html and the default browser.
IS106: Program icon is missing or damaged. Restore resources/ from the distribution.
IS201: Required helper is missing. ip/ss: iproute2; nmcli: network-manager; ethtool: ethtool. Affected data remains empty.
IS202: Query failed or timed out. Check device support and access permissions. Other data remains usable.
IS203: Query returned invalid or oversized data. Check the tool version and refresh.
IS299: Unexpected collection error. Check logs/ and refresh.
IS301: Report could not be saved. Check destination, free space and write permissions.
IS401: Installation or removal failed. Check the reported path and permissions; retry the operation.
locally_administered: Locally administered MAC – vendor cannot be inferred
extended_missing: Some data is missing or could not be read. Check the query status.
diagnostics_hint: These tests send network traffic on request. Enter a target IP or hostname. Name lookup may use DNS/mDNS. Ping: 4 packets; route: at most 12 hops; timeout: 20 seconds. Tests only run when you click Run test.
IS204: Invalid test target. Enter an IP address or hostname without spaces or options.
live_hint: Passive samples with actual elapsed time, UTC timestamp and min/max over the last 60 seconds. RX = receive, TX = transmit. Utilization requires a known physical link speed. Initial samples and counter resets do not yield a rate; this is not an Internet speed test.
missing_packages: Missing packages – these queries are unavailable
services_hint_admin: Local TCP/UDP sockets. A local port is not necessarily reachable from the network.
anonymize_hint: Addresses are replaced with tokens. Names, process details and free diagnostic text are removed. Local data is unchanged.
since_counter_reset: Cumulative since the last counter reset; exact start unknown
rx_drops_review: Review: high cumulative RX drop count. Check driver and queue counters; this does not prove a hardware defect.
driver_counters_not_additive: Linux and driver counters may count different or overlapping events. Compare the values; do not add them.
bluetooth_unavailable_hint: No usable BlueZ controller. Hardware may be unavailable or passed through to a virtual machine.
routes_hint: IPv4/IPv6 main-table default routes ranked by metric. Policy rules, router preference and multipath routing can affect the actual route for each destination.
logs_hint: Current session error log (logs/errors.log). Refresh reads new messages. The next application start clears the log.
logs_empty: No log entries in this session.
IS107: Cannot read logs/errors.log. Check the file, read permissions and UTF-8 encoding, then refresh.
download_hint: Download to {path}, then install into languages/ and help/. Temporary downloads are deleted afterwards. Existing files are preserved. Source: GitHub, version 1.5.4. An active download continues after closing this dialog.
download_done: ✓ Added {count} files. Select the language and press Save.
IS108: Language/help download failed. Check your internet connection and write access to ~/Downloads, languages/ and help/, then retry. Files already saved completely are preserved.
